# Runs the codegen suite one MODULE GROUP at a time, APPENDING a verdict per group.
#
# Two things this script exists for, both learned the hard way in this session:
#
#  1. RESUME. A single 110-minute `cargo test` run was killed four times and left nothing behind.
#     A group whose header is already in the verdict file is skipped, so an interruption costs
#     only the group that was in flight.
#  2. NO CARGO. The machine showed 16M pageouts and ~65MB of free pages; the kills were memory,
#     not tests. It is the BUILD/LINK phase cargo re-runs before filtering that costs the R
